full_judgment: 13. In compliance with the interim order, the Officer-in-Charge of Kamalnagar Police Station and the respondent No. 8 appeared before this Court through their learned Advocate with the relevant documents. From the documents, it appears that on the date of issuance of the Rule, Kamalnagar Police Station started Kamalnagar Police Station Case No. 04 dated 14-2-2017 under sections 143/323/324/ 325/354/500 of the Penal Code against the respondent No.8 and the respondent No.8 also obtained bail in the case on 20-2-2017 and the police could not arrest the respondent No.8 as he was not available in his office as well as in the locality In order to examine whether the respondent No.8 was available in the office or in the locality, we passed several orders as to whether he made any monitory transaction on behalf of the Union Parishad or he performed any function of the Chairman between the period from 14-2-2017 to 20-2-2017. In this regard, we also called for the Bank Statements as well as Ledger Books of the concerned branches of Sonali Bank and Krishi Bank. We also called for a report from the Upazila Nirbahi Officer. From all the reports, it is found that the respondent No. 8 during the period from 14-2-2017 to 20-2-2017 did not perform any function as the Chairman. However, the respondent No. 8 also filed some medical documents relating to the treatment of his father in Shohrawardi Medical College and Hospital, Dhaka from which it appears that the respondent No. 8 did not candidly stated the facts to be true. In order to further examine as to whether the petitioner made any monitory transaction, we also directed the Secretary of the Union Parishad namely, Abduz Zaher to submit the Account Register. The Secretary in compliance with our order appeared before this Court along with six Account Registers. In course of close examination of those Account Registers, the Secretary confessed that some of the signatures of the former Chairman namely, Ali Ahmed were put in the Register by himself. Thereby, he tried to show that some amount of money were expend during the period of the former Chairman. But he also said that he put the signature at the instruction of the former Chairman. In order to verify his submission, we also directed the former Chairman namely, Ali Ahmed to appear before this Court. He initially denied that he instructed the Secretary to put his signature, but at one stage, he said that he was not sure whether he gave such instruction. However, he did not deny that those amounts of money were expended during his tenure. In such facts and circumstances, we also directed the Secretary to show cause as to why a proper legal action should not be taken against him. In reply to the show cause notice, he filed an application through his learned Advocate praying for mercy of this Court with an undertaking that he would not repeat such Irregularities in future. In the backdrop of facts, we took up the matter for hearing.
